messages.text: Morning all. SAR draft v0.4 is in Self-Assessment & QIP › 2025-26. Exec deadline is 30 Oct. Please add evidence to your sections this week — every judgement needs a source.
Validated achievement data uploaded: 83.8% overall. Academy table is pulled straight from the ILR R14 snapshot, so it matches funding.
Thanks Nicole! I'll drop the observation grade profile and development areas into section 3 today.
Hannah — can we triangulate the 'targets not SMART' theme? Observations, the Ofsted recommendation and the review audit all say the same thing, which is strong evidence that we know ourselves.
Yes — I'll reference all three. Review audit is a bit old (Feb) though; flagged Red on the evidence map.
Leadership section: Q4 OTJ audit shows no ineligible claims. Q1 sampling finishes 27 Oct — I'll update once done.
Inclusion section updated with safeguarding totals for the year — aggregate only, no case IDs. Please don't paste anything from Case Management into the SAR.
Noted, thanks Grace. Aggregate is all we need.
Learner voice: NPS +31. Top negative theme is OTJ time. Adding to participation section.
v0.8 done. Achievement now Strong standard. Going to exec Thursday, then Board on 10 Dec. Thanks everyone — great teamwork.
Read it last night — really clear. One ask: can the People/Digital gap mention the coach vacancy is now filled?
